t: The WET Blueprint: Why Your Next App Should Repeat Itself
s: This article introduces Pipulate, a local-first web framework challenging the DRY principle with a WET (Write Everything Twice) approach. It leverages FastHTML and HTMX to eliminate traditional JavaScript frameworks and templating, enabling direct HTML fragment manipulation for simpler, more transparent, and future-proof applications.
sub: Pipulate: A local-first web framework using Python functions as HTML templates.
WET (Write Everything Twice) vs. DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) philosophy.
Leveraging HTMX for over-the-wire HTML fragment delivery to manipulate the DOM directly.
Challenging traditional frontend frameworks by using HTML standards and server-side rendering.
AI's role in making WET coding more manageable through code convection and easy transplants.
